description: Report a passage you believe is wrong, outdated, or uncited, after a koskamo_retrieve answer looked off. No key needed. Reports go to the Koskamo reviewers; nothing changes until a person checks the source. Use koskamo_propose_revision instead when you hold the corrected text and an API key.

dataset.description: Dataset id or slug the passage came from

document_id.description: Optional document id from the retrieve citation

note.description: What is wrong and, if known, the correct value or a URL that shows it

passage.description: The passage text you dispute; or send query instead

query.description: The question that surfaced the passage, when you no longer have the passage

name: koskamo_report_fact
title: Report a disputed passage
